description: This file 'trigger_decoder.cpp' contains trigger decoding logic for an engine control system. It manages trigger event detection, synchronization, error handling, and RPM calculation. The code defines classes for trigger state management, functions for processing encoder signals, synchronization logic, and callback mechanisms, all related to interpreting engine trigger signals and managing trigger synchronization within the firmware.

classes.name: TriggerState
classes.description: Class representing the state of the trigger system, including current event counts, synchronization status, and error statistics.

classes.name: TriggerStateWithRunningStatistics
classes.description: Extension of TriggerState that includes methods for RPM calculation and running statistics.

methods.name: findTriggerZeroEventIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of the synchronization trigger event within the trigger shape, simulating the cycle for duty calculation.

methods.name: initTriggerDecoder
methods.description: Initializes trigger decoder hardware interface pins.

methods.name: initTriggerDecoderLogger
methods.description: Assigns a shared logger for trigger decoder debug messages.
